text: SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge's largest owners are sparebankstiftelser (savings-bank foundations): seven owner foundations hold around 45 percent of the bank, which was formed when SpareBank 1 SR-Bank and SpareBank 1 Sørøst-Norge merged on 1 October 2024 and is headquartered in Stavanger.
short: Seven savings-bank foundations own around 45% of SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge.

source.name: SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge: Om konsernet
source.quote: Våre største eiere er sparebankstiftelser. Syv eierstiftelser eier rundt 45 prosent av SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge.
